comment: LEVEL, FREQ and SPEED are endless encoders, configured with infinite limits at Test_Osc.cpp:139-141; the value each one moves is kept in a separate parameter with no widget of its own (FREQ INDEX, ABS LEVEL, REF LEVEL and SPEED at :148-151), which is why the census lists twelve parameters and only eight positions. ABS LEVEL runs from 0.000015848931924611107 to 1.0, which is -96dB to 0dB, and moves 0.1dB a detent through adjustFactorByDb at :198. The sweep span is SWEEP_START_FREQ 20 and SWEEP_END_FREQ 20000 at :106-107, and the free range is LOG_START_FREQ 20.6 and LOG_END_FREQ 19912 at :108-109. The third-octave table is at :49-54; OCT steps the index by three and clamps it to 2 to 29, which is 31.5Hz to 16000Hz, while 3RD uses the whole table, 20Hz to 20000Hz. The reset to index 17, or to 1046.5Hz at LOG, is settingChange at :374-382. White noise is doubled before the output at :325 while the sine is not, so the two peak at the same voltage for a given LEVEL. The pink filter coefficients are at :329-331. The module has no appendContextMenu at all.
